updates.headline: Correction: only Delhi's primary schools moved online; schools in Noida and Gurugram stay open
updates.body: An earlier update said schools across Delhi NCR had moved online. Only Delhi's primary schools have; schools in Noida and Gurugram remain open.

updates.headline: Building work stops and diesel trucks are kept out of Delhi under the emergency rules
updates.body: The emergency rules also ask offices to let staff work from home where they can.

updates.headline: Schools across Delhi NCR move classes online until Friday
Air quality across Delhi NCR falls to 'severe' as readings pass 450
updates.body: Readings in Delhi, Noida and Gurugram crossed 450 before dawn on Monday, the worst so far this season. Doctors advise people with breathing problems to stay indoors.
